qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: OEM qualification and engineering patents fail to yield economic rents. 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 2.5-4.5%, deeply sub-hurdle, as powerful automotive OEMs demand continuous cost reductions and pass inflationary component costs back onto suppliers.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Chronic capital inefficiency with 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 2.5-4.5%. Squeezed between concentrated OEM customer buyer power and high ongoing R&D/capex requirements for electrification and ADAS.
qualitative.evidence: Historical GAAP ROIC has persistently tracked between 2.5% and 4.5% across 2021-2024. Operating margins are thin (~3-4%), and operating cash flows are largely consumed by tangible capex and capitalized R&D to service OEM contracts.
